name: Hard Boiled Eggs/Devilled Eggs
description: A classic deviled egg recipe with a creamy yolk filling, garnished with paprika and optional olive slices.

recipeInstructions.text: Place the eggs in a covered saucepan with enough cold water to cover them. Bring to a rapid boil, then turn off the heat and let stand for 15 minutes.
Cool the eggs by filling the pot with cold water and changing it frequently until the eggs are cool.
Remove the shells and rinse the eggs to remove any bits of shell.
Slice the eggs in half lengthwise and carefully scoop out the yolks into a bowl.
Mash the yolks with a fork or pastry blender until smooth.
Add mayonnaise and mix until the yolks reach a creamy consistency. Optionally add mustard, chives, and pickle relish to taste.
Scoop the yolk mixture back into the egg white halves.
Garnish with paprika and/or olive slices as desired.
Chill the deviled eggs until ready to serve.
